question: Observation
answer: I took this photo in a UCSB dorm room while three students were studying math together. All three students were looking at the same laptop screen, which showed maths problems and notes. The room was mostly quiet, except for short conversations about solving the problems and the occasional typing noise. One student leaned closer to the screen while another pointed things out and discussed possible answers. The desk lamp gave the table a warm glow, while the rest of the room was calm and quiet.
The shared laptop screen reflects teamwork and collaborative problem-solving during a stressful academic task.
The close physical distance suggests trust, familiarity, and comfort between the students.
